subject.title: [Workspace panel] Root path drops leading dot, false 'Missing' labels on existing folders, broken layout

question: Should session workspace listings expose existence, size, or mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace root, or should false Missing be solved without external filesystem metadata?
rationale: The remaining backend fix choice affects the Gateway file metadata boundary, and the open PR already demonstrates that a plausible repair can bypass fs-safe containment unless maintainers choose the intended product/security semantics.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
options.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths remain hidden, filtered, or neutral, and the false Missing UI is solved without raw filesystem metadata exposure.

options.title: Expose External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: The Gateway may show existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned external paths, but only with explicit security acceptance, tests, and documented semantics.

options.title: Split Layout From Backend
options.body: Land only any remaining Control UI layout repair now and defer external-path Missing semantics to a separate boundary decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: External or fs-safe-rejected paths remain hidden, filtered, or neutral, and the false Missing UI is solved without raw filesystem metadata exposure.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace browsing and fs-safe file preview work makes this the strongest owner for the remaining boundary choice.
